## Nutrient calculations

This document is for analysing Maroochy River long-term and Yandina and Coolum Creek short term water quality datasets, and for estimating how water quality would change with successional tidal restoration.

### 1. Set up

Load packages.

```{r Load_packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(readxl)
library(lubridate)
```

Get data. Water quality data for the Maroochy River and our channel locations, and rainfall data for the Maroochy River.

Also prepare data. Some data are recorded as the wrong type so change to numeric.

```{r Get_data}
# old data, keeping here for reference
#MaroochyWQ <- read_excel(here("Data/WQ_Maroochy_River_HLW_to2024.xlsx"), sheet = "UseMe") %>% 
#  mutate(Nox_mgL = as.numeric(Nox_mgL),
#         Pheopigments_ugL = as.numeric(Pheopigments_ugL),
#         Total_P_mgL = as.numeric(Total_P_mgL))

MaroochyWQ <- read_excel(here("Data/WQ_Maroochy_River_HLW_to2026.xlsx"), sheet = "Estuarine Marine Data", skip = 3) %>% 
  mutate(Ammonia_mgL = as.numeric(case_when(Ammonia_mgL == "< 0.002" ~ 0.002,
                                  .default = as.numeric(Ammonia_mgL))),
         Nox_mgL = as.numeric(case_when(Nox_mgL == "< 0.002" ~ 0.002,
                                  .default = as.numeric(Nox_mgL))),
         Pheopigments_ugL = as.numeric(case_when(Pheopigments_ugL == "< 0.1" ~ 0.1,
                                  .default = as.numeric(Pheopigments_ugL))),
         FRP_mgL = as.numeric(FRP_mgL)) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(Location %in% c("E01505", "E01506", "E01509"))

MaroochyWQ_E1505 <- MaroochyWQ %>% filter(Location == "E01505") %>% 
  select(Survey_date, Nox_mgL) %>%
  mutate(Year = year(Survey_date),
         Month = month(Survey_date)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Nox_mgL))
  
ChannelWQ <- read_excel(here("Data/BlueHeart_Nov2024_WaterSampleData.xlsx"), sheet = "WaterSampleWithLab_cleanforpape") %>% 
  mutate(Temp_degC = as.numeric(Temp_degC),
         DKP_av = as.numeric(DKP_av),
         Location = substr(Site, 1, 3))

Ch2025WQ <- read_excel(here("Data/Water_quality_drains_2025.xlsx")) 

Maroochy_Rain <- read_csv(here("Data/Sunshine_Coast_Airport_Rainfall_040861.csv")) %>% 
  select(Year, Month, `Monthly Precipitation Total (millimetres)`) %>% 
  rename(Rain_mm = `Monthly Precipitation Total (millimetres)`) %>% 
  mutate(Month = as.numeric(Month))

# join Maroochy_Rain and Maroochy_WQ_E1505 together
Maroochy_rain_WQ <- inner_join(MaroochyWQ_E1505, Maroochy_Rain, by = c("Year", "Month")) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Nox_mgL))
```

Compare between restoration scenarios.

Key dates are:

-   pre-2018: no restoration

-   May 2018: 3a (YCW) restoration

-   \~November 2024: 1A, 1B and 1C restoration

```{r Compare_scenarios}
# make a new column for scenario
MaroochyWQ_E1505 <- MaroochyWQ_E1505 %>% 
  mutate(Scenario = case_when(
  Survey_date < as.POSIXct("2018-05-01 00:00:00") ~ "Pre-Restoration",
  Survey_date < as.POSIXct("2024-07-01 00:00:00")  ~ "3A Restoration Only",
  Survey_date > as.POSIXct("2024-10-31 00:00:00") ~ "3A, 1A, 1B and 1C Restoration",
  .default = "Transition"),
  Month = month(Survey_date),
  Month_char = month(Survey_date, label = TRUE, abbr = TRUE)
) %>% 
  filter(Scenario != "Transition") # remove transition category

MaroochyWQ_E1505 <- MaroochyWQ_E1505 %>% mutate(Scenario = factor(Scenario, ordered = TRUE, levels = c("Pre-Restoration", "3A Restoration Only", "3A, 1A, 1B and 1C Restoration"))) # make restoration an ordered factor

# plot distribution of values in each scenario
ggplot(MaroochyWQ_E1505, aes(x = Scenario, y = Nox_mgL)) +
  geom_boxplot()

# make a model to compare scenarios, while accounting for month
M <- glm(Nox_mgL ~ Month + Scenario, data = MaroochyWQ_E1505)
plot(M) # not normal
M2 <- glm(log(Nox_mgL) ~ Month + Scenario, data = MaroochyWQ_E1505)
plot(M2) # not normal
M3 <- glm(sqrt(Nox_mgL) ~ Month + Scenario, data = MaroochyWQ_E1505)
plot(M3) # not amazing but a lot better

summary(M3)

# explicitly test how adding scenario changes the model
M3a <- glm(sqrt(Nox_mgL) ~ Month, data = MaroochyWQ_E1505)
anova(M3, M3a)

# explicitly test how adding month changes the model
M3b <- glm(sqrt(Nox_mgL) ~ Scenario, data = MaroochyWQ_E1505)
anova(M3, M3b)

# month is near significant, summarise stats for NO3 in each month
NO3_by_month <- MaroochyWQ_E1505 %>% group_by(Month_char) %>% summarise(mean = mean(Nox_mgL), min = min(Nox_mgL), max = max(Nox_mgL), median = median(Nox_mgL))

# summarise NOx in each scenario
MaroochyWQ_summ <- MaroochyWQ_E1505 %>% group_by(Scenario) %>% 
  summarise(NOx_mean = mean(Nox_mgL), NOx_min = min(Nox_mgL), NOx_max = max(Nox_mgL), NOx_median = median(Nox_mgL))

# also plot by month
P <- ggplot(MaroochyWQ_E1505, aes(x = Month_char, y = Nox_mgL, group = Month)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_classic() +
  xlab("Month") +
  ylab("NOx (mg/L)") +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 18))
P

#ggsave(here("Output/fig/NutByMonth.png"), width = 2400, height = 1600, units = "px", P)
```

We are also interested in typical values of all parameters in the Maroochy River estuary, over time and in specific months.

Let's focus on gauge E1505 because it is closest to our study area.

```{r Maroochy_WQ}
MaroochyWQ_E1505_all <- MaroochyWQ %>% dplyr::filter(Location == "E01505") %>% 
  mutate(Year = year(Survey_date),
         Month = month(Survey_date))

# summarise each parameter that's relevant to our measurements by month
Maroochy_by_Month <- MaroochyWQ_E1505_all %>% group_by(Month) %>% 
  summarise(mean_Total_N_mgL = mean(Total_N_mgL, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_Ammonia_mgL = mean(Ammonia_mgL, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_Organic_N_mgL = mean(Organic_N_mgL, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_Nox_mgL = mean(Nox_mgL, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_DO_mgL = mean(DO_mgL, na.rm = TRUE),
            `mean_DO_%` = mean(`DO_saturation_%`, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_pH = mean(pH, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_Total_P_mgL = mean(Total_P_mgL, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_Salinity_gL = mean(Salinity_gL, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_Conductivity_mScm = mean(Conductivity_mScm, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_Temp_deg = mean(Temp_degC, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_Turbidity_NTU = mean(Turbidity_NTU, na.rm = TRUE))

# calculate averages for oct-dec, or the three months around our water quality collection period
Maroochy_E01505_Oct_to_Dec <- MaroochyWQ_E1505_all %>% filter(Month %in% c(10:12)) %>% 
  summarise(mean_Total_N_mgL = mean(Total_N_mgL, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_Ammonia_mgL = mean(Ammonia_mgL, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_Organic_N_mgL = mean(Organic_N_mgL, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_Nox_mgL = mean(Nox_mgL, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_DO_mgL = mean(DO_mgL, na.rm = TRUE),
            `mean_DO_%` = mean(`DO_saturation_%`, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_pH = mean(pH, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_Total_P_mgL = mean(Total_P_mgL, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_Salinity_gL = mean(Salinity_gL, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_Conductivity_mScm = mean(Conductivity_mScm, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_Temp_deg = mean(Temp_degC, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_Turbidity_NTU = mean(Turbidity_NTU, na.rm = TRUE))
```
